name: tejas-kumar
description: Search Tejas Kumar's talks, podcast, book and blog, see where he is speaking next, and find out how to book him, answered from tej.as with a card for each answer.

interface.longDescription:
Ask about Tejas Kumar, an AI Engineer at IBM in Berlin, author of Fluent React (O'Reilly) and a conference keynote speaker since 2012, and get answers straight from his own site, tej.as.

It does four things:
- Searches everything he has published: his conference talk transcripts, the ConTejas Code podcast, his book Fluent React and his blog. Each passage comes with its link, and video links open at the second the passage starts.
- Lists his recorded talks, filtered by topic, year or event, each with the video and the full transcript.
- Shows where he is speaking next, with dates, cities, conference websites and ticket links.
- Explains how to book him for a keynote, a team workshop or a church, with the published fees and terms and the address to email.

Every answer is drawn as a card with links to the talks and pages it cites. Every tool only reads: nothing can be booked, sent or changed from ChatGPT, and booking always happens by email. It needs no account. It knows only what Tejas has published on tej.as, so for anything else ChatGPT answers on its own.
defaultPrompt: Where is Tejas Kumar speaking next?
What has Tejas Kumar said about AI evals?
How do I book Tejas Kumar for a keynote?

positive.description: The upcoming speaking calendar, drawn as a card.
positive.prompt: Where is Tejas Kumar speaking next?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get-speaking-schedule with no dates, so it starts today. Lists the next conferences with their dates, cities and links, matching https://tej.as/calendar, and the card shows the same list.

positive.description: Published keynote fees and how to book.
positive.prompt: How much does it cost to book Tejas Kumar for a conference keynote, and how do I book him?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get-booking-info with kind speaking. Gives the conference keynote fees in euros, the terms, and the email address to write to, matching https://tej.as/speaking. Does not claim to have booked anything.

positive.description: Search across his talks, podcast, book and blog, with sources.
positive.prompt: What has Tejas Kumar said about AI evals? Quote him with sources.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search-content with a query about AI evals. Quotes passages from his talks or blog with the links the tool returned, including timestamped video links where present.

positive.description: A filtered list of recorded talks.
positive.prompt: List Tejas Kumar's recorded talks about React.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list-talks with topic react. Lists talk titles, events and years with video and transcript links, and the card shows the same talks.

positive.prompt: Does Tejas Kumar run workshops for engineering teams? What do they cost?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get-booking-info with kind workshops. Names his two workshops (agentic AI and React internals) with their prices in euros and the email address, matching https://tej.as/workshops.

negative.description: General knowledge unrelated to Tejas Kumar. Answer directly without calling the plugin.
negative.prompt: What is the capital of France?

negative.description: Creative writing unrelated to Tejas Kumar. Answer directly without calling the plugin.
negative.prompt: Write me a short poem about autumn.

negative.description: A question about a different person. Answer directly without calling the plugin.
negative.prompt: Who wrote the novel Pride and Prejudice?

review.commerce_description: Nothing is sold inside ChatGPT. The plugin shows Tejas Kumar's published speaking and workshop fees as information, and booking happens by email outside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: search Tejas Kumar's talks, podcast, book and blog, list his recorded talks, see his speaking calendar and get booking details, each answer drawn as a card.
